limits: Representative frame and motion checks do not quantify flicker across every surface; temporal reconstruction can soften fine lines or ghost during disocclusion.
Some narrow baked seams and fine trim retain visible artifacts. This release reduces motion aliasing; it is not a claim of an artifact-free Cycles match.
Final sunset assets were visually reviewed in WebGL 2; WebGPU validation of the same rendering code occurred before activating the new lighting data.
No sustained GPU benchmark, mobile qualification or new manual test of all four chairs was performed in this lighting revision. Prior interaction review is archived separately.
